entries.515a91d1dd8cdad5: In its management policy, the company states that since its founding in 1987 it has provided products and services that meet the needs of each era, with "planning ability and sales capability" as its strengths, and that it will leverage these strengths to take on the challenge of creating new markets. As issues to address, for the Embedded Finance Business it cites expansion into the industrial sector and nearby areas, strengthening the supply of cubicle-type high-voltage receiving equipment and the electrical construction division, and developing a structure to handle large-scale projects such as public works; for the Media & Promotion Business, it cites strengthening collaboration with financial institutions for "Axel Japan," strengthening collaboration with the SBI Group on local government tie-up advertising for the electronic magazine "Tabiiro," and accelerating growth through the creation of new businesses.
entries.5557b3868e1492dc: This reportable segment provides "Nexyz ZERO," which supplies the latest energy-saving equipment and other equipment with zero initial investment, including installation costs, and handles user acquisition work and sales of energy-saving equipment and other equipment. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥23,233 million. The equipment that can be introduced covers many items, including commercial LED lighting, air conditioning and refrigerators, as well as kitchen equipment, water-flushing equipment, agricultural equipment and industrial equipment (such as cubicle-type high-voltage receiving equipment); NEXYZ.Group Co., Ltd., NEXYZ. Co., Ltd., NEXYZ. Facilities Co., Ltd. and others carry out this business. NEXYZ. Facilities Co., Ltd. also provides the electricity supply service "Nexyz Power."
